AI Contract Review and Drafting

Review contracts, draft with your standards, and search every deal you've signed.

Contracts at the speed of commerce
Spellbook is the most complete AI suite for commercial legal work, trusted by 4,500+ in-house teams and law firms worldwide. Spellbook is tuned for commercial legal work, and powered by state-of-the-art LLMs like GPT5 and Opus.

How modern legal operations flow through Spellbook

Bring order to incoming work
New contracts come in from email, Slack, Salesforce, and wherever else deals start.

Get a first pass on every contract
Spellbook redlines each contract against your playbooks and flags the terms that need attention.

Put your contracts to work
Signed contracts are stored automatically and indexed so you can search your full history.

The gold standard in AI contract review
Spot risks and add redlines to your contracts—right in Word.

Draft and revise at lightning speed
Draft clauses and documents from scratch, or use your preferred precedents.

The AI agent for multi-document drafting and review
Say goodbye to Ctrl + C Ctrl+V
Spellbook works where you do - directly in Word. Draft and review 10x faster without switching windows or endless copy and paste.

Answers you can trust, with citations

Compare contracts to market
Compare your contracts to thousands of similar agreements.

Over 10 million contracts accelerated
